settings.about.showAllSettings.descripti: Reveal every setting and transcription model from upstream Handy, including the ones Shorthand hides.
settings.about.showAllSettings.label: Show all Handy settings
settings.advanced.followStream.descripti: Allow local tools to follow live transcript events by running `handy --follow-stream`.
settings.advanced.followStream.label: Follow live transcript output
settings.advanced.switch.description: Show every setting, not just the ones most people need. Nothing moves — the extra rows appear in the sections they belong to.
settings.advanced.switch.label: Advanced settings
settings.advanced.systemAudio.descriptio: Capture audio playing through your speakers as a separate speaker-labelled transcription alongside the microphone.
settings.advanced.systemAudio.label: Capture system audio
settings.advanced.systemAudio.muteConfli: Turn off Capture System Audio before enabling Mute While Recording.
settings.advanced.systemAudio.permission: Shorthand needs permission to record audio playing on this Mac. Grant it in System Settings, under Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording. macOS only asks once, so the prompt may not appear again.
settings.advanced.systemAudio.streamingR: System audio capture requires a model that supports streaming.
settings.advanced.systemAudioDevice.desc: Choose the device to capture. Default follows the system default output.
settings.aiCleanup.dictationNote: AI cleanup is intended for Dictation. Enabling it for notetaking is an advanced setting and is not recommended.
settings.aiCleanup.sharedNote: The connection and the prompt library are shared. Whether cleanup runs, and which prompt it uses, is set per mode under Modes.
settings.aiCleanup.title: How AI cleans up what you said
settings.assistedNotes.enable.descriptio: Turn on a solo note-taking mode. It streams what you say to whatever is following along, the same way Meetings does, but records only your microphone and never types into the window you are in.
settings.assistedNotes.enable.label: Enable assisted notes
settings.assistedNotes.enable.shortcutCo: Could not enable assisted notes: another application is already using one of its shortcuts. Choose a different shortcut below and try again.
settings.assistedNotes.privacy.saveRecor: Keep the audio of each assisted-notes session so you can play it back or re-transcribe it.
settings.assistedNotes.privacy.saveTrans: Keep the text of each assisted-notes session in your local history.
settings.dictation.enable.description: Turn on a separate dictation mode, with its own shortcut, that pastes text into whatever window has focus.
settings.dictation.enable.label: Enable dictation
settings.dictation.enable.shortcutConfli: Could not enable dictation: one of its shortcuts is already in use, either by another Shorthand shortcut or another application. Choose a different shortcut below and try again.
settings.dictation.footer: Microphone, model and language come from the Capture and Transcription sections.
settings.dictation.overlayPosition.share: Where the overlay appears on screen. Shared with meeting mode — this isn't a per-mode setting.
settings.dictation.postProcessing.hint: Configure providers, API keys and models in the Post-Processing section.
settings.dictation.privacy.saveRecording: Keep the audio recording for each dictation.
settings.dictation.privacy.saveTranscrip: Keep the transcript text for each dictation.
settings.general.shortcut.bindings.assis: The keyboard shortcut to start and stop an assisted-notes session.
Optional: a dedicated shortcut that always applies AI cleanup to an assisted-notes session.
settings.general.shortcut.bindings.dicta: The keyboard shortcut to start and stop dictation.
Optional: a dedicated hotkey that always applies AI cleanup to your dictation.
settings.modes.description: Meetings and Assisted notes both stream what they hear to whatever is following along. Meetings can include the other participants; Assisted notes records only you. Dictation types what you say into the focused window.
settings.modes.heading: How each mode behaves
settings.modes.shared.description: One setting, used by whichever mode is recording.
settings.modes.shared.title: Shared by both modes
settings.modes.tabs.label: Capture mode
settings.notes.obsidian.description: The Shorthand plugin for Obsidian follows each capture and writes the note into your vault. It runs inside Obsidian, so that is where it gets installed.
settings.notes.obsidian.status.awaitingO: Obsidian is opening on the plugin's page. Choose Install, then Enable, and come back here. If Obsidian shows its Community plugins settings instead, turn off Restricted mode and try again.
settings.notes.obsidian.status.checkFail: Could not check whether the plugin is installed: {{error}}
settings.notes.obsidian.status.installed: Installed in {{vault}} but switched off. Turn it on in Obsidian under Settings → Community plugins.
settings.notes.obsidian.status.notInstal: Not installed in {{vault}}. Obsidian will open on the plugin's page; choose Install, then Enable.
settings.notes.obsidian.status.noVault: Obsidian is installed but has no vault yet. Open or create a vault in Obsidian, then come back here.
settings.notes.obsidian.status.obsidianN: Obsidian isn't installed on this computer, or hasn't been opened yet. Install Obsidian and open a vault, then come back here.
settings.notes.obsidian.title: Obsidian
settings.notes.plugin.title: Shorthand plugin
settings.notetaking.setup.description: Notetaking modes stream your transcript to a follower, which writes the note using a Claude Code or Codex assistant running on this computer. A paid Claude or ChatGPT subscription already includes one. Install it and sign in before your first capture; no API key is needed.
settings.notetaking.setup.title: Set up AI note taking
settings.privacy.saveRecordings.descript: Keep the audio of each transcription in your recordings folder so you can play it back or re-transcribe it. Off by default; no recording is kept.
settings.privacy.saveRecordings.label: Save recordings
settings.privacy.saveTranscripts.descrip: Keep the text of each transcription in your local history. Off by default; no transcript is kept.
settings.privacy.saveTranscripts.label: Save transcripts
settings.privacy.title: Privacy
transcript.retryUnavailable: Retry is unavailable for transcripts containing system audio.
